name: Nyxxx
source:
You play as a regular gamer - a modern, ironic guy who knows his way around pop culture. One stormy evening, a sudden lightning bolt strikes your house, activating a half-forgotten souvenir sitting on your shelf. Sounds familiar isn't it?

Before you know it, a mysterious portal opens up, dragging you straight into a familiar fantasy world. You find yourself trapped inside a hilarious and sexy parody of Baldur's Gate 3! The very first person you encounter in this magical realm is none other than the beautiful Isobel. She, along with plenty of other gorgeous fantasy babes - from horny tieflings to naughty goblin girls - are more than eager to help you find your way back home... or make sure you never want to leave!

What paths will you choose? That's up to you!

[From [url=https://kaeg3d.itch.io/nyxxx-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名普通游戏玩家——一个深谙流行文化、爱吐槽的现代青年。在一个风雨交加的夜晚，一道突如其来的闪电劈中了你的房子，激活了书架上一件早已被遗忘多时的纪念品。听起来很眼熟，对吧？

还没等你反应过来，一道神秘的传送门骤然开启，将你直接拽进了一个似曾相识的奇幻世界。你发现自己被困在了《博德之门3》的爆笑香艳恶搞世界里！在这片魔法大陆上，你邂逅的第一个人不是别人，正是美艳动人的伊索贝尔。她与其他众多风情万种的奇幻美人——从欲火焚身的提夫林到顽皮撩人的地精少女——都迫不及待地想要帮你找到回家的路……或者让你彻底乐不思蜀、永远不想离开！

你将踏上怎样的道路？一切由你决定！
